title: A People’s History Of The United States

questions.q: Whose perspective does Zinn's book take?
questions.why: The overview says it tells the story from the perspective of the oppressed.

questions.q: What was the settlers' biggest fear, per lesson 1?
a: Slaves and lower-class whites joining against the rich
questions.why: Lesson 1 says elites feared an alliance to overthrow them.

questions.q: What share of the nation's wealth did the top 1 percent control by 1770?
Why did Lincoln wage the Civil War, according to Zinn in lesson 2?
a: To end slavery out of justice
questions.why: Lesson 2 says it wasn't humanitarian but about the Union and interests.

questions.q: What was Roosevelt mainly concerned about in World War II, per lesson 3?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says his primary concern was resources the US depended on.
